info.title: shinyhttpserver
info.description: Serves a directory over HTTP from the command line: a browser file manager with upload, rename and delete, and the same address mounts as a WebDAV drive in Finder or Explorer. Basic auth, per-operation permissions (read/create/update/delete), optional TLS and a public tunnel. Installs as a .NET tool.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Serves a directory over HTTP: a file manager in a browser, and a WebDAV drive in Finder or Explorer.

options.name: --address
options.description: Address to bind: an IP, 'any' (all interfaces) or 'localhost'. Defaults to every interface so other devices can reach it. [default: 0.0.0.0]

options.name: --prefix
options.description: URL prefix the directory is mounted at. [default: /]

options.name: --allow
options.description: Operations to allow: read, create, update, delete, all. Repeatable or comma separated. Read is always allowed. [default: Read]

options.name: --user
options.description: Enables basic auth with user:password. Repeat for more than one user. [default: Shiny.Net.HttpServer.CommandLine.BasicUser[]]

options.name: --realm
options.description: Basic auth realm shown in the browser prompt. [default: shinyhttpserver]

options.name: --auth-changes-only
options.description: Leaves reads open and only requires a login for create/update/delete. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-insecure-auth
options.description: Allows basic auth over unencrypted, non-loopback connections. The password crosses the network in the clear on every request. [default: False]

options.name: --https
options.description: Serves over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate generated at startup. Clients will warn about it. [default: False]

options.name: --tunnel
options.description: Opens a public pinggy.io tunnel and shares that address instead of the LAN one. Anonymous tunnels stop after 60 minutes. [default: False]

options.name: --tunnel-token
options.description: A pinggy.io access token, which lifts the 60 minute cap an anonymous tunnel has. Implies --tunnel.

options.name: --hidden
options.description: Includes dotfiles and hidden files in listings and downloads. [default: False]

options.name: --no-qr
options.description: Leaves the QR code out of the banner. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Directory to serve. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]
